```markdown
# Formdata

> Formdata is a hosted form backend for HTML, static websites, Webflow, Framer, React, and JavaScript applications. It lets developers collect form submissions without building and maintaining their own backend.

Formdata provides a backend for websites and applications that need to receive, process, and manage form submissions.

## Product

- Collect form submissions from HTML and static websites.
- Use Formdata with React and JavaScript applications.
- Protect forms against spam and automated submissions.
- Receive notifications when forms are submitted.
- Manage and export collected submissions.
- Connect form submissions with external services.

## Website

- [Formdata](https://formdata.cloud/): Official website and product overview.
- [Privacy Policy](https://formdata.cloud/privacy-policy): Formdata privacy policy.
- [Terms of Service](https://formdata.cloud/terms-of-service): Formdata terms of service.

## Usage

Formdata is intended for developers and website builders who need form submission handling without implementing their own backend infrastructure.

The official website is the authoritative source for current product capabilities, pricing, limitations, and terms.
```
